question: A boat goes 10 km upstream in 50 minutes, and the speed of the stream is 3 kmph. Find the speed of the boat in still water (in kmph).
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Upstream Speed = Distance ÷ Time

Upstream Speed = 10 ÷ (50/60) = 10 × (6/5) = 12 kmph

Speed of boat in still water = Upstream Speed + Speed of stream

Speed of boat = 12 + 3 = 15 kmph

**∴ The correct answer is 15 kmph.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Distance traveled upstream = 10 km

Time taken = 50 minutes

Speed of the stream = 3 kmph

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/371936b9be9e51e479f85e1fbe7246cf4cc86ef390d26e611fe737783a5d2ece.png] 

**Formula Used:**

Speed = Distance ÷ Time

Upstream Speed = Speed of boat in still water − Speed of stream

**Calculations:**

⇒ Time taken = 50 ÷ 60 hours = 5/6 hours

⇒ Upstream Speed = 10 ÷ (5/6)

⇒ Upstream Speed = 10 × (6/5) = 12 kmph

⇒ Let the speed of the boat in still water be u kmph.

⇒ 12 = u − 3

⇒ u = 12 + 3 = 15 kmph

**∴ The correct answer is 15 kmph.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Downstream Speed

When the boat moves in the direction of the stream. Downstream Speed = Speed of boat + Speed of stream.

Speed of Boat in Still Water

If both upstream and downstream speeds are known: Speed of Boat = (Downstream Speed + Upstream Speed) ÷ 2.

Speed of Stream

If both upstream and downstream speeds are known: Speed of Stream = (Downstream Speed − Upstream Speed) ÷ 2.
